state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 5 (Install and Guides) is in progress. Install is done, and the Tour has its first step.**

Install has four pages: `install/index.mdx` (build from source, with Windows, Linux and macOS tabs), `hello-world.mdx`, `editor.mdx` (the VS Code extension, from `docs/reference/tools/40-editor.md`) and `server.mdx` (folders and permissions, from `docs/reference/tools/15-install.md`). Their snippets are under `website/snippets/install/`. Every Install page ends with a link to the Tour. Novis has no release yet, so the install page says so and builds from source.

Guides has one section so far, "A Tour of Novis": `guides/tour/index.mdx` and `guides/tour/01-methods-and-types.mdx`, snippets under `website/snippets/guides/tour/`. Novis has no free functions (`E0215`), so every Tour snippet uses a class with `public static function`. A snippet must exit 0, so a compile error is shown as a `txt` block copied from a real `nvs check`.

`site structure`, `stale`, `reference`, `syntax` and `--build` pass. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stage 6 rewrites. `guides`, `apps` and `in-depth` are stubs in `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` (`LATER`, line 66).
